scope: A small playable engine-validation slice. These nine situations are not Patch 1 and do not count toward the Patch-1 minimum.

approvalRequirements: Save compatibility, deterministic replay and offline QA

runtimeRules.choiceResolution: Validated local transaction; outcomes hidden until selected
runtimeRules.replayPolicy: A situation cannot recur until two other situation resolutions have occurred in the same journey.

limitations: This is a starter playable slice, not the completed life simulator.
Only region, character age, local time/day-cycle, weather and saved event history are currently represented in the first context contract.
Relationship, inventory, current-activity and broader EP-2 simulation contracts remain pending.
Travel, quests, work/study loops, combat, progression breadth, SQLite transaction migration, and physical-device QA remain pending.
